name: Podcast Explainer (long-form, faceless)
description: Audio-first long-form explainer (5-30 minutes, 16:9): a podcast, monologue, or interview audio track turned into a faceless overlay-driven video in the style of dev/tech YouTube essayists. No talking head — every claim in the voiceover is illustrated with a fullscreen overlay (code block, terminal screenshot, tweet card, browser frame, meme, diagram, quote card, chapter card). Captions are centered chunks (8-15 words, Inter Bold), pacing is jump-cut on silence with zoom punch-ins on emphasis, audio is a constant music bed ducked under VO with whoosh/pop SFX on transitions. The pipeline takes an audio file (or YouTube URL → audio), word-level transcript, and an LLM-generated overlay plan, then composes a HyperFrames timeline that scales to 30 minutes via chapter sub-compositions.
